text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: After finishing lunch, I went for a stroll and ran into Curren Bouquetd'or sitting down and reading a book.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Ah――
Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: It's a photobook... of flower bouquets.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: ...It's really educational. Because I... love making bouquets, too.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Who you want to give them to, the occasion—
The flowers you choose change depending on their purpose.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Of course—it is not merely the flowers.
The wrapping, the scents, and so many different combinations—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
...Ah. Forgive me, did I—
did I talk too much?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: ――I'm glad, to hear that.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Many girls get utterly carried away when talking about their passions,
but Curren Bouquetd'or remains modest.
So much so that it only makes you want to hear more.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If Curren Bouquetd'or were to make a bouquet for someone precious, what kind would it be?
I decide to ask her that question.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Someone precious—to me, is it?
Let me think... For instance—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Supposing I were to give it to Mother...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Colors that evoke the sun—and the warmth
of the air bathed in its light—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
I want to give a bouquet that makes them feel—
at ease the moment they receive it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That image was surely how
Curren Bouquetd'or envisioned her mother.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Thinking of the other person—choosing and considering.
Spending time like that is... truly enjoyable.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Watching Curren Bouquetd'or speak with such a gentle expression on her face—
choice_data_list: Whoever receives that must be so happy.
Whoever receives that must be so happy.
Now I feel like giving a gift to someone myself.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Watching Curren Bouquetd'or speak with such a gentle expression on her face—
choice_data_list: Whoever receives that must be so happy.
Whoever receives that must be so happy.
Now I feel like giving a gift to someone myself.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: —Is that what you think?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
The feelings poured into this bouquet――
if only they reach them.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
...I'm happy too.
If we can share the very same feelings—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: That is... a truly wonderful, happy thing.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
You've taken――an interest, have you?
...That makes me happy.
choice_data_list: Could you help me pick out some flowers?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Of course.
Please... allow me to assist you.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
So that you――and the one receiving it,
can surround yourselves with a beautiful bouquet
and feel at peace――

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
